statement.p: The four sequential sides of a quadrilateral have lengths \displaystyle{a}={4.7}, \displaystyle{b}={5.6}, \displaystyle{c}={6.7}, and \displaystyle{d}={8.3} (all measured in yards). The angle between the two smallest sides is \displaystyle\alpha={95}.
What is the area of this quadrilateral?
